text:
maria: Quick note 0: found a couple of broken anchors and an inaccurate SDK snippet in the Dedicated provisioning docs (autoscale policy section). I'm opening a small cleanup PR.
kevin: thanks. can you paste the snippet that's wrong?
olivia: :eyes: i saw a report where docs show `cooldown: 30` and users assumed seconds. our JS SDK uses milliseconds in v2.
maria: exact. doc currently shows `cooldown: 30` which reads like 30s. i'll include both notations and a migration note. also two TOC anchors 404: `#tenant-isolation` and `#eviction-behavior`.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7892 labels: docs, provisioning, quickfix.
sam: for wording around isolation, can we standardize on "isolation decorator" to avoid conflating with network isolation? used that phrasing in SLA doc.
maria: good call. i'll replace "tenant isolation" with "isolation decorator" and add a parenthetical about network-level isolation where applicable.
judy: can we add a minimal YAML example that passes `yarn gen:docs` so CI will catch broken anchors?
maria: adding a smokeable snippet. proposed YAML:

```
scalePolicy:
  type: autoscale
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 8
  cooldownMs: 30000  # newer SDKs use milliseconds
  targetUtilization: 0.6
isolation:
  decorator: tenant-prefer
```

kevin: looks good. add a short migration callout explaining older SDKs accepted `cooldown` in seconds.
maria: will add that at top of the autoscale subsection + a migration checklist.
sam: include a one-liner test in the PR description: `yarn gen:docs && grep -n "tenant-prefer" site/_build` so maintainers can validate anchors.
maria: added test step and fixed the two broken TOC links. also updated CHANGELOG entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md: "provisioning: fix anchors, clarify isolation decorator, add autoscale YAML with cooldownMs example".
olivia: :thumbsup: can we also mention in the SDK snippets page that examples prior to v2.4 use seconds for cooldown? saves confusion.
kevin: good idea. if this PR is only docs-side, we should also open a follow-up to update sample repos that embed snippets.
maria: filing follow-ups for sample repos after this merges. pinged @judy and @kevin as reviewers on PR.
judy: i'll review the SLA overlap wording specifically. add me as reviewer for that section.
maria: done. plan to merge after reviews + CI. if anything breaks, we'll revert the TOC edits.
kevin: thanks everyone nice small iterative fix.
